manifest.name: Skip intro videos
manifest.description: Hides the Ubisoft logo, epilepsy warning, autosave notice and disclaimer videos, so the game starts at the title screen. The install is never changed: the videos are hidden inside the launch's own mount.
manifest.audited: 2026-11-16: file list from PCGamingWiki, checked against the installed game (all four files exist). Same deletions as the hand-made 'Skip intros' layer. Saves are unaffected.
